title: Teer asghar ke liye
body:
teer asghar ke liye
barchi akbar ke liye
gardane shabbir thi
kund khanjar ke liye
<<DIVIDER>>
aaye laakhon aadmi
sheh ke ek sar ke liye
teer asghar ke liye...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar kataya shaah ne
deene yawar ke liye
teer asghar ke liye...
<<DIVIDER>>
sar bahattar laaye hai
nazre daawar ke liye
teer asghar ke liye...
<<DIVIDER>>
aahni zanjeer aur
ek laaghar ke liye
teer asghar ke liye...
<<DIVIDER>>
dafn zindan may hui
roti thi ghar ke liye
teer asghar ke liye...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo hamare hai faqat
hum bahattar ke liye
teer asghar ke liye...
<<DIVIDER>>
daulate matam mili
zindagi bhar ke liye
teer asghar ke liye...
<<DIVIDER>>
pyaas sheh ki bad gayi
aab e khanjar ke liye
teer asghar ke liye...
<<DIVIDER>>
halq ne shabbir ke
bosay khanjar ke liye
teer asghar ke liye...
<<DIVIDER>>
ashk bhi bechain hai
deedaye tar ke liye
teer asghar ke liye...
<<DIVIDER>>
aankh pani laayi hai
pyase asghar ke liye
teer asghar ke liye...
<<DIVIDER>>
maula kuch to sochiye
apne anwar ke liye
teer asghar ke liye...
author: Anwar Zahir
